historical_source_directory_note: The repository folder named supabase is a historical source-path name only. It is not a runtime target.

upstream_certificate.consumer_rule: Accept only the exact server-owned certificate UUID/reference, selected-set digests, channel manifest and current session fence; never accept browser constituent arrays.

zero_drift_authority.rule: Transport and orchestration may change. Eligibility, identity, amount, sign, gross/net, tax, VAT, channel, payee, headroom, grouping, reservations, finance effects, cancellation, execution and settlement policy may not change.

proved_current_failures.proof: The Worker materialises the complete selected set before chunking and repeats it in operation input.
proved_current_failures.required_correction: Persist only a compact certificate reference in the operation and page server-owned rows.

proved_current_failures.proof: The current owner rejects more than 100 selected ids and contains two LIMIT 100 selections.
proved_current_failures.required_correction: Build the exact frozen Candidate/channel scopes from normalized certificate-backed rows with no hidden cap.

proved_current_failures.proof: Each call restarts sequence numbering at one, so independent pages cannot safely append to the same phase.
proved_current_failures.required_correction: Use normalized deterministic phase units and a separate atomic finalise step.

proved_current_failures.proof: The Worker marks a chunk complete after one owner call and ignores has_more returned by paged item, snapshot, breakdown and finalizer owners.
proved_current_failures.required_correction: Persist one receipt per owner iteration and advance only after has_more=false and exact remaining-row reconciliation.

proved_current_failures.proof: The current finance owner accepts Candidate scope arrays but has no bounded continuation contract.
proved_current_failures.required_correction: Add an owner-preserving bounded adapter/replacement whose page filter changes no finance equation or category semantics.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_frozen_certificate_scopes_v8
relations.purpose: One compact immutable certificate identity and channel manifest per Draft operation.
relations.rule: STAGING may become FROZEN only after exact constituent and partition reference counts and digests match the H1 certificate under the session fence.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_frozen_constituent_refs_v8
relations.purpose: One certificate UUID plus ordinal reference per selected constituent; no duplicate source-row JSON.
relations.rule: References are page-staged from the exact immutable H1 certificate and retained indefinitely.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_frozen_partition_refs_v8
relations.purpose: One certificate UUID plus ordinal reference per authoritative Candidate/channel partition.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_frozen_candidate_scopes_v8
relations.purpose: One compact row-backed Candidate/channel scope per authoritative certificate partition.
relations.rule: The shell carries counts, totals and identity only; complete membership remains normalized.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_frozen_candidate_scope_members_v8
relations.purpose: Normalized partition membership whose configured ceiling is 50,000 without an array; performance/load proof is bounded to 5,000 rows.
relations.rule: Each selected constituent appears exactly once in exactly one certificate-owned Candidate/channel partition.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_frozen_stage_receipts_v8
relations.purpose: Bounded page cursor and receipt chain for response-loss-safe staging.
relations.rule: At most 256 rows and 524288 canonical bytes are admitted per page; a changed replay request fails closed.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_phase_units_v1
relations.purpose: Deterministic appendable phase units without JSON membership arrays.
relations.rule: INSERT SELECT from frozen Candidate scopes assigns global stable ordinals once; finalisation proves count, distinct identity and digest before any unit can be claimed.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_owner_receipts_v1
relations.purpose: Atomic response-loss/replay receipt for each bounded owner invocation.
relations.rule: The same request returns the stored receipt; a changed request or non-next iteration fails closed. A unit completes only when the owner reports no more work and independent remaining-row checks agree.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_finalizer_iterations_v8
relations.purpose: One immutable receipt for each existing finalizer LIMIT 100 invocation.
relations.rule: has_more advances to another short RPC; completion requires zero independently counted remaining rows.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_constituent_parity_results_v8
relations.purpose: Exact per-constituent comparison of H1 expected facts with actual allocation, item, reservation and materialisation outputs.
relations.rule: The first mismatch blocks completion. The comparison records existing-owner outcomes and never recalculates economics.

relations.name: private.banking_pay_draft_operation_terminal_results_v8
relations.purpose: Byte-compatible legacy terminal result plus additive certificate diagnostics.
relations.rule: No existing Worker or frontend result field may be removed, renamed, retyped or reinterpreted.

candidate_scope_contract.rule: Small Candidate/channel facts required by unchanged owners remain on the shell; constituent-sized collections live only in normalized rows.

owner_adapter_rules.strategy: Exact replacement reads at most 100 next frozen source rows from the normalized relation while retaining every current allocation/recovery/headroom expression and fail-closed check.
owner_adapter_rules.completion: No unallocated normalized row remains for the unit.

owner_adapter_rules.strategy: Reuse unchanged with no more than 100 Candidate scope ids.
owner_adapter_rules.completion: Every supplied scope is linked to the expected batch Candidate.

owner_adapter_rules.strategy: Exact replacement obtains canonical selected rows from the normalized relation; existing LIMIT 100 and has_more semantics remain authoritative.
owner_adapter_rules.completion: has_more=false and no expected ordinary allocation remains without an item or certified finance defer.

owner_adapter_rules.strategy: Exact owner-preserving replacement/adapter processes one bounded deterministic finance-allocation page and retains all current equations, aliases, PAYE/Umbrella treatment, item types and case transitions.
owner_adapter_rules.completion: Every certified finance allocation in the unit is linked exactly once and the owner plan parity check passes.

owner_adapter_rules.strategy: Reuse unchanged one iteration at a time and obey has_more.
owner_adapter_rules.completion: has_more=false and no eligible unreserved row remains.

owner_adapter_rules.strategy: Reuse unchanged one iteration at a time and obey has_more.
owner_adapter_rules.completion: has_more=false and every touched Timesheet has its current-owner snapshot.

owner_adapter_rules.strategy: Reuse unchanged one iteration at a time and obey has_more.
owner_adapter_rules.completion: has_more=false and no eligible item lacks its current-owner breakdown.

worker_contract.operation_input: Compact certificate reference only; no selected constituent arrays.
worker_contract.unit_claim: One phase unit receipt at a time; each RPC performs at most one bounded database page.
worker_contract.completion_rule: Never finish a chunk, phase or operation while the owner receipt says has_more or an independent remaining-row count is nonzero.
worker_contract.old_operation_rule: Legacy operations continue only through their exact legacy route. Missing or mixed certified metadata fails closed; there is no implicit fallback.

frontend_transport_contract.current_source_evidence: The existing Create Draft page constructs full selected row-id, constituent-contract and economic-key arrays, repeats them across request fields, and deep-copies the complete body for preflight before any bounded Draft phase starts.
frontend_transport_contract.new_submission_rule: After the existing selection-sync step has completed and the server has certified that exact current selection, the certified Create Draft preflight and start requests carry only the session/version/progress context, requested channel scope, existing same-week PAYE override proof when applicable, and the compact server-issued certificate reference or issuer request. They never carry selected constituent arrays or constituent contracts.
frontend_transport_contract.selection_authority_rule: The browser remains responsible for the user's selection interaction, but the Draft start consumes only the server-certified selection. Browser arrays are never accepted as Draft authority and cannot override, reconstruct or narrow the certificate.
frontend_transport_contract.result_rule: The terminal operation result, created batch IDs, replacement-or-patched Workbench refresh contract, frontend progress interpretation and every existing downstream field retain their current meaning and type. Certificate and paging diagnostics are additive only.
frontend_transport_contract.legacy_rule: Already-started legacy operations retain their exact legacy input and result path. New certified operations cannot fall back to legacy array input.

page_size_review.decision_rule: Use 256 for lightweight certificate and normalized scope transport based on the bounded 101, 1001 and 5000-row measurements on both engines. Keep the distinct financial owner page at 100. Re-measure at no more than 5000 rows against the sealed shared candidate and Miget TEST before release; never increase a financial owner page without separate source and runtime proof.

policy_separation.f013_scope_and_insert_items: Separate provisional correctness work. It may be combined into final owners only after its own unchanged-policy parity gates pass.
policy_separation.f013b: CLOSED_NOT_DEFECT. PAYMENT_ADVANCE_REPAYMENT visible input and LOAN_REPAYMENT hidden/frozen vocabulary remain deliberately distinct.
forbidden: headroom or recovery recomputation outside the existing owner

release_gate: Local implementation and disposable proof only. No shared publication, Miget mutation, Worker deployment or real Draft until independent review and explicit user consent.
